analysis_source_status: Inspected and copied at packaging; not claimed to be pre-run frozen.
rng: numpy.random.default_rng; reset to the same seed for EVERY interval.
sampling: Sample n indices with replacement for each of 5000 replicate means; percentile 0.025/0.975.
pairing: example_id within task; retain task_conditioned insertion order.
clusters: Mean paired differences within topic, then equally resample topic means in insertion order; absent topic falls back to query ID.
weight_sensitivity: Use saved G/S with G weights 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.55, 0.75, 1; no new scoring.
scope: Retained matched study only; not external/historical interval regeneration or scientific validation.
